content: SMC detection pitfalls: swing high/low definitions commonly use a centered window (N bars before AND after) which by construction repaints and leaks future information - a swing is only confirmed N bars later, so any ML feature or backtest must use confirmation-shifted swings or trailing (fractal-confirmed) detection; equal highs/lows liquidity pools need a relative tolerance (ATR- or percentage-scaled) rather than exact equality; zone detection must be evaluated with bar-by-bar information sets to avoid lookahead bias; the popular smartmoneyconcepts PyPI lib (0.0.27, dev status Planning, educational disclaimer) implements centered-window swings and is useful as a reference/cross-check, not as a production detector.
